title: Junction Temperature of the below mentioned parts
content:
Hi ST Team,

Can You pls share the Junction temperature of the following Parts.
LSM6DSVTR   M24M01E-FMN6TP

scraped_replies.html:
Both devices are designed for the temperature range -40...+85°C. The junction temperature is in the same range due to negligible self-heating, so it is not specified explicitly.

Does it answer your request?

Regards
/Peter

Hello Peter, 

More information require regarding this parts, can  you help me for the thermal resistance values for the parts. 

Thanks and Regards
Harsh

As I mentioned before, the datasheet does not specify any thermal resistance values because of the low current consumption and, therefore, low power dissipation. However, you are welcome to create a personal ticket with the Online Support OLS and try to obtain further information.

Good luck!
/Peter

Hello Peter,

Thank you for the response, this resolve my query.

Thanks and Regards
Harsh.
